name: SDWPF compositional physical-event semantic memory
description: Independent observable event factors that add a conservative residual to the train-calibrated stable/up/down trend prompt. Multiple factors may coexist. The all-zero factor vector means that the Wiki must not intervene.

scenes.title: Gust or turbulence event factor
scenes.prompt: As one composable residual factor, recent wind-speed variability or abrupt wind jumps indicate that smooth trend continuation may lag. Apply only a confidence-controlled correction and combine it with any simultaneously supported physical factor.
observable_evidence: recent wind-speed standard deviation above its frozen threshold
or recent absolute wind-speed step above its frozen threshold

scenes.title: High-wind low-power event factor
scenes.prompt: As one composable residual factor, sufficient observed wind with persistently low observed power calls for conservative continuation rather than aggressive recovery. This is an observable state, not a diagnosis of curtailment, failure, or shutdown cause.
observable_evidence: recent mean wind speed above the active-wind threshold
recent mean power below a rated-power ratio threshold

scenes.title: Rated-saturation event factor
scenes.prompt: As one composable residual factor, power close to rated capacity should restrain an unconstrained upward trend while preserving a decline already visible in the history.
observable_evidence: recent mean power near rated capacity

scenes.title: Low-wind idle event factor
scenes.prompt: As one composable residual factor, low recent wind together with low recent power supports a conservative near-zero correction unless recovery is already evidenced by the ordinary trend prompt.
observable_evidence: recent mean wind below the low-wind threshold
recent mean power below a rated-power ratio threshold
